messages.text: Ada, I recorded your confirmation this morning that Publish completed for the original approved Redpoint Assurance release after the repair. The later edited release is a different request: it contains changed content and now names rev-later-draft, so it needs a new named approval before Publish becomes available. I’ve put that follow-up in CUSTO-10 and will help you get the right reviewer. The revision labels here are redacted case references. We’ll keep the usual Policy Gates and audit checks.

Victor, we have the proposed preview for Ashland Group’s saved kit proposal ASH-KIT-P2. The [selector report](https://www.notion.so/b87c58b15e824d4999ada3d9cbf4b615) has the saved page variants, exclusions and targets shown in that preview. Can you check whether those targets match the scope your site owner saved? Sofia is reviewing the current preview in ENGIN-19. We have no report of a live page change.
Quick check on Olivecoast Initiative's manual Migration Map handoff. Since the scope answer has gone out, should I give them an import date for the two forms?

No date. The manual answer covered scope. The campaign signup destination and consent wording still need confirmation, and no import date was promised. Keep the supplied inquiry destination and domain contact in the record before anyone uses the configuration.

The editor browser check is accepted in ENGIN-14. I'm copying the recorded job definition, fixture, result and artifact references from the handoff into the readable runbook table. The old CircleCI job doesn't need another run.
For our next customer review, I need to compare Redpoint Assurance, Juniperpeak Group and Ashland Group. Which needs our attention first, and what should happen next for each?
